WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
), above_average AS (
  SELECT order_count
  FROM side_counts
  WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM side_counts)
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS sum_of_counts,
       AVG(order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM side_counts)) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average;
